  },
  "quick_facts": {
    "one_line": "Self-registration, JWT (7d), two roles (OWNER/ADMIN), token_version for session invalidation.",
    "status_reason": "Pending: eam.md pivot. Auth needs full rework from V-Smart Ledger spec.",
    "last_change": "2026-04-15 — Spec pivot to Lean Inventory MVP.",
    "key_links": [],
    "status": "done"
  },
  "content": {
    "title": "Authentication & Authorization",
    "tldr": "Users self-register with email+password. System creates a JWT (7 days). Two roles: OWNER (shop owner) and ADMIN (platform operator). Admins are seeded in DB — not self-registerable. Disabling a user increments token_version to invalidate all active sessions.",
    "summary": "Auth module covers: register (OWNER only via public endpoint), login, logout. JWT contains userId, role, tokenVersion. On every request the server verifies tokenVersion matches user.token_version — mismatch returns 401. Admin accounts are seeded directly into the database.",
    "use_cases": [
      "UC-01: Register & Start Using",
      "UC-01b: Login",
      "UC-09: Disable/Enable User (admin increments token_version)"
    ],
    "do_not": [
      "Do NOT allow admin role creation via POST /auth/register — always creates OWNER",
      "Do NOT store refresh tokens — single JWT, 7 day expiry",
      "Do NOT return passwordHash in any API response",
      "Do NOT allow login if user.status = DISABLED"
    ],
    "business_rules": [
      "Rule 8: Disabled user cannot log in",
      "Rule 9: Admin accounts are seeded, not registered",
      "Rule 10: Password min 8 characters",
      "Rule 11: Token versioning for session invalidation"
    ],
    "entities": [
      "User: id, email, password(hashed), role(OWNER|ADMIN), status(ACTIVE|DISABLED), token_version(int), created_at"
    ],
    "api_endpoints": [
      "POST /auth/register — { email, password } → creates User(OWNER) + Workspace + JWT",
      "POST /auth/login — { email, password } → validates + checks status + issues JWT 7d",
      "POST /auth/logout — clears client-side token (server stateless)"
    ],
    "roles": [
      {
        "role": "OWNER",
        "description": "Shop owner. Self-registers. Can manage their own workspace products and transactions."
      },
      {
        "role": "ADMIN",
        "description": "Platform operator. Seeded in DB. Cannot access shop data. Manages users and views platform stats."
      }
    ]
  }
}

    "last_change": "2026-04-15 — Spec pivot to Lean Inventory MVP.",
    "key_links": [],
    "status": "done"
  },
  "content": {
    "title": "Product Management",
    "tldr": "OWNER creates and edits products within their workspace. Quantity is never edited directly — it changes only via Import/Export transactions. Stock status (IN_STOCK / LOW_STOCK / OUT_OF_STOCK) is computed at read time from quantity + threshold.",
    "summary": "Products belong to a workspace. Each product has name (required), SKU (optional, unique within workspace), quantity (>=0, starts at 0), and threshold (>=0, default 0 = no alert). Product list is sorted: OUT_OF_STOCK first, then LOW_STOCK, then IN_STOCK, alphabetical within group.",
    "use_cases": [
      "UC-02: Create Product",
      "UC-03: Edit Product (name, SKU, threshold only — not quantity)"
    ],
    "do_not": [
      "Do NOT allow quantity to be set via product create or edit endpoints",
      "Do NOT store stock status — compute it at read time",
      "Do NOT allow threshold < 0",
      "Do NOT expose products from other workspaces"
    ],
    "business_rules": [
      "Rule 1: quantity >= 0 at all times",
      "Rule 5: Workspace isolation — products belong to a workspace",
      "Rule 6: threshold=0 disables low-stock alert"
    ],
    "entities": [
      "Product: id, workspace_id(FK), name, sku(optional, unique/workspace), quantity(int>=0), threshold(int>=0), created_at, updated_at"
    ],
    "stock_status": {
      "OUT_OF_STOCK": "quantity = 0",
      "LOW_STOCK": "quantity <= threshold AND quantity > 0 AND threshold > 0",
      "IN_STOCK": "quantity > threshold"
    },
    "api_endpoints": [
      "GET  /products?page=1&limit=50 — list all (sorted by status, then alpha)",
      "POST /products — create { name, sku?, threshold? }",
      "GET  /products/:id — single product",
      "PUT  /products/:id — update { name?, sku?, threshold? }"
    ]
  }
}

bugs.title: SprintView: Dependencies blank for Sprint 2 & 3 due to schema field mismatch
bugs.description: Schema inconsistency: sprint-1.json uses 'dependencies' while sprint-2.json and sprint-3.json use 'prerequisites'. SprintView only merged the former, so the latter was silently ignored.

bugs.title: ImpactMap section index crashes with React error #31 for relation files with goal-as-object
bugs.description: In wiki-app/app/wiki/[section]/page.tsx, the loadPreview() function had: `(d.goal as string | undefined)`. TypeScript cast does not convert the value at runtime — for files that use goal: { statement, metric, deadline }, the object was silently passed through and then rendered verbatim in JSX, triggering error #31.

bugs.title: Login succeeds but user is immediately redirected back to /login — TransformInterceptor envelope not unwrapped on frontend
bugs.description: The global NestJS TransformInterceptor (backend/src/common/interceptors/transform.interceptor.ts) wraps every response payload. The frontend api-client.ts had NO envelope-unwrapping logic, so every apiClient call received the envelope as the payload. This silently broke login (and would have broken all product API calls too once auth was working).

bugs.title: Admin user storeId null coerced to empty string in JWT strategy causes UUID crash in all products endpoints
bugs.description: backend/src/modules/auth/strategies/jwt.strategy.ts line 40: `storeId: user.storeId ?? ''` coerces null to empty string. The empty string is an invalid UUID. ProductsService and StoresService had no null guard before passing storeId to repository queries.

bugs.title: eam_backend crashes at startup — @nestjs/event-emitter missing from Docker anonymous node_modules volume
bugs.description: docker-compose.yml defines an anonymous volume '- /app/node_modules' on the backend service. This volume is created on first container start and populated from the image layer. On subsequent 'docker compose up --build' the image IS rebuilt with the new package.json, but Docker REUSES the existing anonymous volume. The bind-mount '- ./backend:/app' overlays the host source, and the stale anonymous volume shadows /app/node_modules — missing @nestjs/event-emitter entirely.

pages.title: Business Workflow — Authentication & Session Lifecycle
pages.data:
{
  "meta": {
    "version": 1,
    "last_updated": "2026-04-12",
    "title": "Business Workflow — Authentication & Session Lifecycle",
    "owner": "vibe-ba"
  },
  "quick_facts": {
    "module": "auth",
    "entities_involved": [
      "User"
    ],
    "external_systems": [
      "Redis (session store)"
    ]
  },
  "content": {
    "tldr": "Covers the full lifecycle of a staff session: account creation → login → token refresh → logout → deactivation.",
    "workflows": [
      {
        "id": "WF-AUTH-01",
        "title": "New Staff Account Creation",
        "trigger": "Admin receives a new employee",
        "steps": [
          "1. Admin calls POST /api/v1/users with email, password, role, storeId",
          "2. System validates: email uniqueness, role enum, storeId active, password length",
          "3. System hashes password (bcrypt, cost 12)",
          "4. System creates User record, isActive=true",
          "5. System returns sanitised user (no passwordHash)",
          "6. Admin communicates credentials to employee (out-of-band — email, WhatsApp, etc.)"
        ],
        "success_outcome": "Employee can now log in",
        "failure_paths": [
          "Duplicate email → 409 — admin must use a different email",
          "Inactive storeId → 400 — admin must reactivate store first"
        ]
      },
      {
        "id": "WF-AUTH-02",
        "title": "Staff Login (Session Start)",
        "trigger": "Staff member opens the app / POS terminal at start of shift",
        "steps": [
          "1. Staff enters email + password",
          "2. Client calls POST /api/v1/auth/login",
          "3. System looks up user by lowercase email",
          "4. System checks isActive=true for user AND store",
          "5. System compares bcrypt hash",
          "6. System creates accessToken (JWT, 15 min) with payload { sub, email, role, storeId }",
          "7. System creates refreshToken (random UUID), stores in Redis key refresh:{userId} with TTL 604800s",
          "8. System returns { accessToken, refreshToken, user }",
          "9. Client stores both tokens securely (memory for accessToken, httpOnly cookie or secure storage for refreshToken)"
        ],
        "success_outcome": "Staff is authenticated and can call protected endpoints",
        "failure_paths": [
          "Wrong password or unknown email → 401 'Invalid credentials'",
          "isActive=false (user) → 401 'Account is deactivated'",
          "isActive=false (store) → 401 'Store is deactivated'",
          "Rate limit exceeded → 429"
        ]
      },
      {
        "id": "WF-AUTH-03",
        "title": "Silent Token Refresh",
        "trigger": "Client detects accessToken is expired (exp check before API call, or 401 response)",
        "steps": [
          "1. Client calls POST /api/v1/auth/refresh with refreshToken",
          "2. System looks up Redis key refresh:{userId} decoded from token",
          "3. System verifies token value matches stored value in Redis",
          "4. System checks user is still active",
          "5. System deletes old refreshToken from Redis",
          "6. System issues new accessToken + new refreshToken",
          "7. System stores new refreshToken in Redis with fresh TTL",
          "8. Client replaces both stored tokens"
        ],
        "success_outcome": "Staff session continues seamlessly",
        "failure_paths": [
          "Token not in Redis (expired or rotated) → 401 — client must redirect to login",
          "User deactivated since last refresh → 401 — client clears tokens, redirects to login"
        ]
      },
      {
        "id": "WF-AUTH-04",
        "title": "Logout (Session End)",
        "trigger": "Staff clicks logout, closes shift, or session is manually terminated",
        "steps": [
          "1. Client calls POST /api/v1/auth/logout with valid accessToken in Authorization header",
          "2. System extracts userId from JWT",
          "3. System deletes Redis key refresh:{userId}",
          "4. System returns 200",
          "5. Client discards both tokens from local storage"
        ],
        "success_outcome": "Session is fully invalidated server-side",
        "failure_paths": [
          "Redis key already gone (already logged out) → 200 (idempotent, no error shown to user)"
        ]
      },
      {
        "id": "WF-AUTH-05",
        "title": "Staff Account Deactivation",
        "trigger": "Employee leaves the business or is suspended",
        "steps": [
          "1. Admin calls PATCH /api/v1/users/:id/deactivate",
          "2. System sets user.isActive=false",
          "3. System deletes Redis key refresh:{userId} (immediate revocation)",
          "4. System returns 200",
          "5. Employee's current accessToken remains valid up to 15-min TTL — accepted risk"
        ],
        "success_outcome": "Employee cannot start a new session; current session expires within 15 min",
        "failure_paths": [
          "userId not found → 404",
          "Caller is not admin → 403"
        ]
      }
    ]
  },
  "audit": [
    {
      "version": 1,
      "timestamp": "2026-04-12T00:00:00Z",
      "author": "vibe-ba",
      "action": "created",
      "note": "Auth session lifecycle workflows created at BA analysis session"
    }
  ]
}

      "All timestamps returned as ISO 8601 UTC strings",
      "All monetary amounts returned as integers (VND, no decimals)",
